title: The Rise and Fall of Lucifer

sense.text:
Obey them that have the rule over you, “for they watch for your souls”. The leader’s job is to watch for the soul of every brother and sister: is this brother all right, is this sister all right, how are they growing in the spirit, how are they dealing with lust. That is why the questions get asked. It is not to be nosy; it is the job.

And it is on the officers and the leaders over the schools to watch for these souls, because Satan’s job is to destroy every last one of us that wakes up to this truth, that we are Israel. His job is to come and take you out. Our job is to build the brothers and sisters up and teach them how to fight and overcome the wiles of the devil.

precepts.why:
“Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.” The herd is the people, the nation of Israel. It is the leaders’ job to know the state of the flock, to know what is going on in the body.

Like a shepherd with one sheep missing: where is that sheep? He goes and inquires and looks for the one he does not see. So if a brother or sister disappears for a couple of weeks, we reach out. If the calls go unanswered, we go by the house to make sure they are all right. That is why there are officers of ten over ten men, calling them every week to see how they are doing, and senior sisters reaching out to the single and young sisters every week. Every sister is supposed to have a counselor; if you are amongst us and you do not have one, something is wrong.

A sister went missing, and brothers and sisters called and went by her house, and finally she sent word: I don’t want to be part of IUIC no more, stop showing up, I’ll take out a restraining order. All she had to do was let us know. We are not chasing anybody down. If you choose not to serve God, go. But remember London: a sister disappeared, took herself off the groups, and the brothers thought she probably just left. We are not making that excuse again. Out of concern we will look for you. Once you say you don’t want to follow Christ no more, we will never call you or show up at your house again, and you will be deleted from the groups. You made your choice.

Most of the time when a sister who has been with us for years just up and disappears, it is her lust: she met a dude in the world, dude blow her back out. Don’t just disappear and leave people thinking something happened to you. Be straightforward. If you want to leave, leave, but let us know.

sense.text: “Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?” Every last one of us falls under the four categories of Israelites in this parable. You have to figure out which one you fall into.

The first type hears the word “by the way side”. That is the brother or sister on the street: they hear the brothers teaching and say, that makes sense. Then “Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.” He takes away that little seed that was planted.

The second type hears the word and “immediately receive it with gladness”. They are glad to hear they are an Israelite. But they “have no root in themselves”: they are not studying, not praying, not applying, not rooted in Christ, not ten toes down. They are here for some other reason: for a friend, for their mom or their pops. They are not here because they love this truth and love Christ.

So they “endure but for a time”. That time could be months, could be a couple of years. Then “when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.” When persecution comes, a lot of brothers will leave. The Bible already tells us what is going to happen, so it is no surprise when brothers and sisters leave. Some of the ones listening right now are not rooted.

The third type is sown among thorns: “the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.” The lust of other things goes even into sex. Some hear the word and receive it with joy, and they are amongst us one year, two years, three, four years, and they are horny. The lust comes in and chokes the word, and they go back into the world to fulfill the lust of the flesh.

Others have one foot in the truth and one foot in the world, trying to become rich, loving this world, and the world ends up choking the word of God. You know if you are being choked: you are not studying, you have no joy to come and congregate, it feels like, I got to go to class. You can feel it in your spirit. If it is happening to you, fast and pray and examine yourself.

The fourth are “sown on good ground”: studying, praying, applying, with roots in this truth, learning to overcome lust and temptations. They “bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.”

You bring forth fruit by going through things. A sister offends you, you go to her and apply Matthew 18, she says she is sorry, and you forgive her. That is bringing forth fruit. If somebody offends you, the Bible tells you how to deal with it.

precepts.why:
“For many are called, but few are chosen.” Many brothers and sisters will be called to this truth, but few of us will be chosen. The chosen are those of us that learn to love each other, that overcome the trials and tribulations, that are rooted in this truth, that don’t let the cares of this world and other things come in and choke the word.

So it is no surprise when brothers and sisters say, I don’t want to be an Israelite no more, I don’t want to serve God no more. They were called, but they are not chosen; they want to go back into the world, and it is what it is. This is not a cult and nobody is held captive. When you leave, just leave, and let us know with an email or a text. But if you go out speaking all types of evil, lying and slandering, then it becomes a problem.

“As ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.” This is the scripture for all of us. It is up to the leaders to guide you and show you what to apply to your life to attain salvation, but every one of us has to work it out.

The leaders are not there with you during the week. You have to fight Satan and overcome the demons you are battling yourself. When Satan comes into your mind saying, that sister did this and that to me, you have to apply the scriptures. That is how the seed on good ground bears fruit.

“But there are some of you that believe not.” Even in the time of Christ, with the twelve apostles and the seventy, there were people amongst him that believed not. It is the same today: some in Jersey, some in New York, some online, here for a friend or going through a phase, not rooted and not believing, and it shows in their actions.

“For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.” Some amongst us now will betray us the same way they betrayed Christ. “No man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.”

“From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him”: went back into the world. They did it to Christ, so some will do it to us. No tears will be shed and nobody will be chased down; we gird up our loins. Christ let them go the same way. If you are fake and phony, just go. Why be around people you don’t really like?

sense.text:
“For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land.” That is not a parable: the one God has mercy on is Jacob, the one he chooses is Israel. It says he will yet choose us because we broke God’s laws and were scattered to the four corners of the earth in slavery. God cast us off, but not for ever.

This is the Lord choosing us, saving us and gathering us from the four corners of the earth where we were scattered as slaves, in the time of destruction. During that destruction, the third world war, God will have mercy on us and save us, and then set us in our own land. “And the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.”

“And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place”. The people are the Israelites. We will take the nations and bring them to their place, not ours. That matters because today the nations are not in their own lands: the Egyptians are not in Egypt, the Arabs occupy all those lands, and the white men came and conquered a lot of lands. We will tell the Chinese, this is where your land is; the Arabs, this is your land; the Egyptians, this land belongs to you. That is justice and judgment, judging righteously.

“And the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were”. We were once slaves; they enslaved us and used us to build America up. This is payback, God’s judgment. “And they shall rule over their oppressors.” The people that oppressed us, we will rule over them. There will be no equality in the kingdom, the same way there is no equality in this kingdom. We are at the bottom of society, and some negroes think they are equal until they take all their money.

“In the day that the Lord shall give thee rest”: the rest is the kingdom of heaven. Come unto me all ye that labour and I will give you rest. Nobody oppressing you no more, living for ever.

Rest “from thy sorrow”: from all the sorrows our people have been through for over four hundred years, and the sorrows about to come on the earth, the beginning of sorrows. “And from thy fear”: the fear of the white man, of losing your job, of oppression, the fear to teach the word of God because you will be put to death for it. “And from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”: that is the four hundred years plus of slavery and Jim Crow here in America, in Britain and in all the countries we were scattered to as slaves.

“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” Those of us who make it out of here take up this proverb. The king of Babylon here is not ancient Nebuchadnezzar; it is America. America is the oppressor: they have oppressed many nations and they are oppressing us. And America is the golden city, because great riches come to nought there; it is the richest country on the planet, and that is why everybody tries to come to America.

“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.” The king of Babylon is called the oppressor, the golden city, and the wicked: different terms for the same one, and another term is coming. “The rulers” shows it is not just one person but a system: the beast system, the red dragon, the rulers of the darkness of this world, governments.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger”: America will bring serious judgment on the nations, and on our people here in America, until nobody has to be told who the oppressor is. Then he “is persecuted, and none hindereth”: the same America will be persecuted, and nobody cares.

When he falls, “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” All the nations will break forth singing. The cedars of Lebanon, the leaders in Lebanon that are left, say, “Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.” Since you were destroyed, nobody comes up against us.
“It hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.” All of it goes hand in hand: this is how the king of Babylon, the wicked, the oppressor, is going to fall.

“Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?” is spoken to Lucifer. “Thy pomp is brought down to the grave”: the grave means the earth. They are brought down; they are not on top of society ruling no more.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” So what is the king of Babylon, the golden city, the oppressor, the wicked called? Lucifer. It is the same people, the same race. It is not speaking of a spiritual demon; the spiritual demon works with them, but this is not talking about that. The identification of Lucifer with Satan is a traditional Christian interpretation, not something the Bible says.

Lucifer is a Latin word meaning lightbringer, or morning star. The Hebrew Bible was not written in Latin; the Hebrew words here, helel ben shachar, mean day star or morning star, son of the dawn, and the Latin Vulgate rendered it Lucifer. It is not a proper name but a descriptive term for the king of Babylon, the system that will be set up. Other Bibles put day star here.

The translators understood that Christ is the bright and morning star. So to put a difference between Christ and the king of Babylon, instead of writing bright morning star they put a Latin word in a Hebrew book, to show it was not speaking about Christ. The Lord was on those translators when they were changing things from Hebrew to English.

Heaven here goes into rulership; Lamentations speaks of the Israelites falling from heaven too. “How art thou cut down to the ground”: he is not ruling no more. “Which didst weaken the nations!” America weakened the nations economically, through policies and sanctions: sanctions that destroyed the Venezuelan economy, the war on Iraq and Afghanistan and the sanctions after, the sanctions on Russia now, and Trump going nation to nation with trade deals and tariffs. And through war and bombing.

“I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”. The sides of the north is North America. Sitting upon the congregation means ruling over the twelve tribes on this side of the world and oppressing them, as with our brothers in Venezuela. People talk about Satan, but it is his children he works with.
“I will be like the most High.” He set himself up as Christ and God, painting images of himself as Christ and God. That is him being like the most High.
“Is this the man”: the king of Babylon, Lucifer, is a man. The man of sin, the beast, the dragon: the white man, Edom.

“That made the world as a wilderness”: that is what America does. Gaza is a wilderness right now; they bombed and destroyed everything there, and America and Israel are behind it. All these things are making them hated.

precepts.why: “For the Lord will not cast off for ever: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.” This is why Isaiah says the Lord will “yet” choose Israel. We broke God’s laws and were scattered throughout the four corners of the earth in slavery, and God cast us off, but he did not cast us off for ever. He has compassion on Jacob and chooses Israel again.

This shows the time frame of the Lord having mercy on Jacob. “Behold, the days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number”: that great number is billions. Billions of people will die on this earth.

“And the way of truth shall be hidden”: the way of truth is the proper understanding of the Bible, and for centuries it has been hidden by the so-called white man. “And the land shall be barren of faith”: there will be so much destruction and war that you will not see people with faith.

“Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.” This is when the Lord will have mercy on Jacob and yet choose Israel. God will empty the earth through war and destruction; billions will die, and it is the Lord who allows it. Right now the world is upside down, and he will turn it right side up.

So stop playing games saying, I don’t want to serve the Lord, I’m leaving IUIC. This is the time to get yourself right; you don’t understand what is coming.

“And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people”. The children of Daniel’s people are the Israelites; that is who Michael stands up to save. Read slowly and put emphasis on the words.

“And there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time”: the third woe, the third world war. There will never be such destruction and death again, and it will happen in some of our lifetimes. Watching the signs, twenty to thirty years tops is how long Babylon lasts, and one of the final signs is when they start putting us to death.

“And at that time thy people shall be delivered.” Not all nations: Daniel’s people, the twelve tribes, delivered from that destruction, from nuclear bombs going off all over the earth while Babylon is destroyed. Christ blows the trumpet and sends his angels to gather his elect from the four corners of the earth.

Being saved most of the time means deliverance from affliction, delivered from that destruction in the last days; it also goes into dying righteous and being with the Lord. He that endures to the end, the same shall be saved: to the end of your life or until he returns. Ten thousand fall on your right hand and another thousand on your left, but it will not come near you. That is deliverance.

Joel says the same thing as Daniel. “Blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke”: that is destruction and war. “The sun shall be turned into darkness”: blacked out from all that war, “before the great and the terrible day of the Lord come.”

“Whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered”: those doing what is right, keeping the commandments, enduring and staying strong. “For in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance”. Zion is a people before a place: the twelve tribes of Israel. Zion dwells with the daughter of Babylon, which is America, so the deliverance takes place here in America first, and then the twelve tribes are gathered from all over the earth.

“And in the remnant whom the Lord shall call.” That remnant is us. We have been called by God, a high calling: God speaks through the teaching, and you heard it.

“There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun”: Jeshurun means upright one, righteous ones, the children of Israel. “Who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky”: this is Christ coming back from the sky in chariots to help us.

“He shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.” The Lord thrusts out our enemies and then tells us to destroy them. “Israel then shall dwell in safety alone”: not the Chinese, not the Edomites. Deliverance is for the twelve tribes of Israel, the oppressed, so stop trying to save a heathen.

“Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord”. There is no other people like us; when Christ comes and changes us we will be equal unto the angels. Israel is the people saved by the Lord, the ones he is coming back to save. The Bible is a plain book: put emphasis on the words.

“And thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee.” Our enemies have lied to us for centuries. The white man set himself up as a Jew, set Christ up as a white man, and told our people they were just slaves, when we are more than that. The same enemies of Deuteronomy 28:48 that put the yoke of iron on our neck lied to us.

“When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.” God gave every nation its inheritance, its land; the bounds are their lands. And he gave us ours.

Today the world is upside down and people live in lands that do not belong to them. So when Israel brings the nations “to their place”, it means putting each nation back in the land God gave it. That is justice and judgment: this land does not belong to you; your inheritance is over there, in the desert, go over there.

“All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.” Every one in his own land. That is after America is destroyed: every nation goes back to its own land. The Lord will command the Israelites to put them back and make sure they stay in the bounds of their land, and nobody will be stealing anybody’s land no more. That proves “bring them to their place”.

This explains the nations becoming servants and handmaids. “And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls”: the Chinese, the Arabs and the rest will build houses for us. “And their kings shall minister unto thee”.

“For in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.” The mercy is on Israel. “Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles”: all their riches coming up.

“He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword.” Christ said it. This is how Israel will take them captives, whose captives we were.

“Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.” That is what we are waiting for, our patience and what we believe. If you don’t believe that, you are not a saint.

“And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations”. If you overcome and keep God’s works to the end, Christ gives you power over the nations. That is ruling over your oppressors, as Isaiah 14 says.

This shows who Babylon is. “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen”: Babylon the great is America, and according to Bible prophecy America will be destroyed and fall.

“And is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.” When this place falls, devils will be over here; this goes into a more spiritual level.

“MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT”. It is a mystery because many do not understand this place is Babylon; they think it is the land of milk and honey, and God says no, this is Babylon. It is a mystery to them, not to us. So when Isaiah 14 says the king of Babylon and the golden city, it is talking about this: America, mystery Babylon the great.

This explains the golden city. “Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls! For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.” In one hour all the riches here in America will come to nought; this place will fall and be destroyed. That is why the king of Babylon is called the golden city: America is the richest country on the planet.

“I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.” Christ is the bright and morning star. The translators understood that, which is why they did not write bright morning star over the king of Babylon in Isaiah 14:12. They put a Latin word, Lucifer, there instead.
“I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob”. That star coming out of Jacob is Christ. He is that star, the morning star.
“As unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. That day star is Christ arising in our hearts. It is not talking about the king of Babylon.

“The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light”. John was sent to bear witness of that light, the bright morning star: Christ. “He was not that Light”. “That was the true Light”: Christ is the true light.

Why does it say Christ is the true light? Now you can see why they call the king of Babylon Lucifer, lightbearer. The Lord was on those translators when they were changing things from Hebrew to English.

“For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” There are even brothers in the truth today calling themselves apostles who are false, and you tell them by their teachings. But the ones who transformed themselves into the apostles of Christ are Christianity, the white man, Edom: they put up white images of the apostles, pictures of Paul, Matthew and Luke as white men, and call themselves Jews.

“And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” “Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness”. His ministers are his children, the so-called white men. Satan did not come to Eve looking evil and wicked; he came as light. His children do the same.

That is why the king of Babylon, the oppressor, the wicked, is called Lucifer, the lightbearer, the morning star: at one point he transformed into righteousness. After World War II, in 1945, America transformed itself into justice, a democratic society that loves humanity and spreads peace and democracy, a Christian nation, a God-fearing society. After they murdered, killed, stole and oppressed, they said: we are the ones ruling the earth now, we can’t lynch the negroes and let the whole world see us, so let us do it secretly and give the slaves equal rights. But do they really love everyone?

“And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.” This white horse is made to look like Christ, but it is not; Christ is the white horse of Revelation 19. This is when the seals are broken: the white man going forth in the name of Christ, conquering Africa and all nations in the name of Christianity.

That is the white man transforming himself into an angel of light. He pushed his religion over the earth, beginning with Pope Nicholas V and the papal bulls, and Pope Alexander VI.

Christ explains the seals in Matthew 24, if you are spiritually able to see it. “Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not. For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.”

That is why America and the king of Babylon are called Lucifer: they transformed themselves into light, into a Christian society, followers of Christ, telling the whole world they are righteous and upstanding. But they are not a God-fearing society, and they enslaved God’s people. It is what they are doing in Nigeria now, saying they will intervene over the persecution of Christians. They always used Christianity, with their Jesuit priests, as a front to get into a nation and take its resources.

So the king of Babylon, the wicked, transformed himself into light. That is the Statue of Liberty: hope, justice, you are saved, the lightbearer, a place of rights and equal rights. That is what comes to people’s minds when they want to come to America. But they were not like that before 1965, the sixties and seventies; they were lynching and killing us and had us under Jim Crow with no rights. They transformed themselves, and now they are going back to their real form, the oppressor.

“How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!” The things of Esau are what he is hiding. The hidden thing is that he is not a Christian society, not the morning star, not the people of Christ. Christ is the morning star.

“For the mystery of iniquity doth already work”: the mystery of iniquity is Lucifer, the king of Babylon, mystery Babylon the great. At that time it was working as Rome, the white man. “Only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way”: until the Lord takes them out of the way.

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed”. Why does the wicked need to be revealed? If he showed plainly that he is wicked, he would not need revealing. He has to be revealed because he is hiding who he really is: he has been transformed into an angel of light, set himself up as the bright morning star, as Christ and the people of Christ, a Christian society about peace and justice. It is our job to reveal that he is the wicked, and we are revealing them right now.

“Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”: by us teaching the word of God. “And shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”: the brightness goes back to the bright morning star. When Christ returns he will destroy them.

“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders”: the beast, Lucifer, coming to power after the working of Satan; his power is his technology. “And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish”: he deceives you into thinking he is a Christian society that loves everyone and cares about your country, lending you money through the IMF, when it is about resources and keeping you at the bottom. Those of our people that perish do so because they were deceived to follow after Lucifer and America’s religion, Christianity. The unrighteousness is worshipping the white image of Christ.

“Because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved. And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”: the lie that the king of Babylon is Christ, that the religion they set up is about Christ. The lie is Christianity. Our people have been deceived to follow Satan’s children, to follow the beast.

“Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face”. God will raise up their skirts and you are going to see everything: the ass, the vagina, all the wickedness and shame America has been doing. That is what Trump is doing. For seventy years America transformed into an angel of light, saying it is righteous, but that time is coming to an end; he is turning back into the oppressor, the man that weakened the nations.

“And I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.” The nations will see the evil America does. “And I will cast abominable filth upon thee”: that is what is happening right now. Even though they set themselves up as a God-fearing society, as the people of Christ, as Lucifer, God says, I will reveal them.

“Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. The man of Isaiah 14 is Edom. “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle”: the nations will say, let us rise up against America in battle. That is the rise and the fall of Lucifer, America, the king of Babylon.

“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” America is greatly despised by all nations and it is getting worse. America will go to war with Venezuela, kill a lot of people there, and rule the nations in wrath. That is the Lord revealing their shame: making them do evil for everybody to see they are not a God-fearing people, not the bright and morning star, not his people, until the nations are angry enough to rise up against her in battle.

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high”: that is where the word Caucasian comes from, the cliffs of the Caucasus mountains in Georgia. That lets you know who Edom is.

“The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.” The heavens revealing his iniquity means America will do a bunch of evil on the earth, and things will get worse and worse: worse than the Iraq war or the Afghanistan war, taking Greenland, bombing Venezuela, evil in Africa, destroying Russia’s economy and Europe’s. All nations will say, let us rise up against America and Israel in battle.

“The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.”

sense.text:
“And there was war in heaven”. This explains how Lucifer is fallen from heaven in Isaiah 14:12. War in heaven is war in kingdoms, the kingdoms warring with each other: the time of trouble, the third woe, all nations at war. In the midst of that world war, Michael and the angels intervene.

“Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels”. The dragon is Lucifer, the beast, Edom. Satan and his angels are the white men and their armies, fighting against Christ and the angels when they return. This is future prophecy: Armageddon, the Lord warring with the nations.
“And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.” They will not win against Michael and the angels, and they will not be ruling no more. That is Lucifer’s fall from heaven.

precepts.why:
“And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.”

The war in heaven is the same moment: the archangel Michael stands up, there is war and a time of trouble, the third woe, and Daniel’s people are delivered. That is why Revelation 12 speaks of Michael fighting.

Who is the dragon? “And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.” The heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, Great Britain, and America the eighth head, with Belgium and the others: basically all the European nations. That great red dragon is what will fight against Christ when he returns, and what Michael will fight against.

This proves the war in heaven is the white man fighting against Christ and the angels. “Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people”: all you heathens out there, listen to the word of God. “For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies”. Indignation is righteous anger. The armies are the dragon’s angels. “He hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.”

“And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll”. The host of heaven is the kingdoms and rulers; they will be dissolved, and “all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine”. They are not ruling no more.

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” That is the war in heaven of Revelation 12:7. So who is the red dragon, the devil and Satan? Idumea, Edom.
